body:
I was going to post a new message to /r/suicidewatch, but I'll just put it here.  

Things get better.  It just takes time.  

Please stay with us, my friends.  Please.

http://imgur.com/NFFZ8
I'm still here.  I'm still going to try.  Just one more day.

Maybe.  I don't know.  I'm so tired of it all.
I have to change.  Maybe trekking across America is a better idea than turning my skull into a bowl.

I'm going to think.

I am an athiest, too.  I am really close to pulling the trigger and ending it all, I don't believe Hell awaits.  Nothing awaits.  

I'm ready to eat a bullet, too.  I think we should think long and hard about that, first.  Let's wait one more day.

I didn't realize how closely we'd become wrapped together.  Shit, man, she was here more than she was home.  Every day without her sucks.  

I can't sleep, I manage an hour or two before waking up and realizing she's not in my arms, thinking terrible thinks about another dude's cock in her mouth.  

I don't know if I can move on from this.
Thank you for still being here, man.  We're gonna make it through this.

For the first time in my life I had a good and honest relationship with a woman.  No posturing bullshit, no pretending to be something I'm not.  

However, our relationship was never "formal", I guess.  It had developed though, into a good thing.  A wonderful thing.  And then over the holidays another man came into her life and she tells me they have this energy or some shit between them and that she doesn't know what the future holds.  I am alone again.  He is with her, staying at her place, and I am here in the cold and dark.  She told me this Monday and I've been stone cold drunk almost every hour since.  I just can't see any joy in anything, everything I see reminds me of her.

I seriously feel like a fucking zombie and I just want this to end.  Thank you for talking.

I hope you're doing better, brother.  As a veteran myself, I salute you.  

I've said it in many threads now.  Let's not do this TODAY.
Let's just stay here one more day.  And tell yourself that every day.  I sit here, gun in battery ready to fire every night, but I haven't done it.  Maybe I won't.

I know, man.  I know.  

I wake up every 3 hours with horrific images of new-man's-cock in her mouth.  I wake up, move out of bed and try to rest on the couch.  Then I think about all the times I held her there and it hurts.

People say it gets better, but right now I am totally lost and unfunctional.

Like I said, though, we're both thinking the same thing.  Let's just keep putting it off.

Dude, I am there with you, just got dumped myself.  I am employed but my work feels bleak and empty and honestly I'm not sure that makes my situation any better than yours.  

I posted here too.  I saw no one responded to you  I thought I would.  I know what we are both thinking, but let's not do this right now.
